narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Thirty divided by six is five, so six is one of the primes!
<bookmark mark='six'/>But six is two times three, so six is not a prime at all.
<bookmark mark='strike'/>Only a prime can go on the left, and six is not one.
removed_beats.on_screen: Chintu's bubble divides thirty by six to get five; six is written in the left column and then split into two times three; the bubble is struck through in the warning colour

narration: <bookmark mark='sum'/>Divide by a prime each time, and stop when the number left is itself prime.
<bookmark mark='yours'/>Your turn. Use the division method to break seventy and seventy eight into primes.
